dining.name: Waterfront Bar and Grill
dining.summary: The waterfront grill — the park's most substantial lunch with lake-side seating and real air conditioning.
description: The waterfront grill anchors the lake-side food row with the park's most substantial counter menu: grilled plates, sandwiches, and the shaded-and-cooled seating that Texas afternoons make precious.
The location beside the stadium makes it the natural pre- or post-show stop.
tips: Claim the indoor tables at the heat peak.
Time lunch against the presentation schedule — the pre-show window is calm.
dining.verdict: The best lunch at the park in the only building that matters in July. Order the plate, sit inside, rehydrate.
